question: What is the TRAPPIST-1 system?
short_answer: TRAPPIST-1 is an ultra-cool red dwarf star located 39 light-years away, hosting seven Earth-sized terrestrial planets, three of which (TRAPPIST-1e, f, and g) orbit within the habitable zone.
full_explanation: Discovered in 2017, TRAPPIST-1 is the premier laboratory for studying terrestrial exoplanet atmospheres, liquid water potential, and stellar flare impacts using the James Webb Space Telescope.
